items.title: GNU Guix Vulnerabilities Allow Remote Privilege Escalation via Malicious Binary Substitutes
items.description: GNU Guix has disclosed four serious security vulnerabilities affecting its package substitution and channel-management features. Three flaws in the guix substitute utility can enable remote privilege escalation, corruption of stored data, and local disclosure of files readable by the build daemon user. At the same time, a fourth issue affects guix pull and guix time-machine. […] The post GNU…

items.description: A Linux kernel vulnerability in the FUSE subsystem can allow a local attacker to gain root privileges by overflowing the page cache with attacker-controlled directory entries. The flaw is tracked as CVE-2026-31694 and affects the code path used when the kernel caches FUSE readdir results.
